V-M-CLI-ENTRY.Scenario: success: Root --help lists the grace subcommands (lint, module, file, status, verification, afk, evolve).

V-M-CLI-LINT.Scenario: success: grace lint produces zero errors on a clean GRACE project.
failure: A missing verification entry referenced by the graph is reported as an error.

V-M-CLI-MODULE.Scenario: success: find resolves modules by name, path, dependency, or verification ref.
success: show returns a module record with verification excerpt when requested.

V-M-CLI-FILE.Scenario: success: file show returns MODULE_CONTRACT, MODULE_MAP, and semantic blocks.

V-M-CLI-STATUS.Scenario: success: status on a fully-initialized project prints a compact summary with context artifacts, graph modules, verification entries, and a suggested next action.
failure: A project missing .grace artifacts reports projectKind none with a next action pointing to grace-init.
success: --format json emits the machine-readable StatusResult.

V-M-CLI-AFK.Scenario: success: grace afk start 1 writes state.json under docs/afk-sessions/<id>/.
success: grace afk tick returns remaining time while the session is fresh.
failure: grace afk tick exits 42 (BUDGET_EXHAUSTED) once expiresAt passes.
failure: grace afk tick exits 43 (NO_SESSION) when no session exists.
failure: grace afk tick exits 44 (SESSION_STOPPED) after grace afk stop.
success: grace afk journal and grace afk defer append to the session markdown files.
success: grace afk report prints a summary and marks the session completed.

V-M-CLI-EVOLVE.Command: bun test src/evolve-spec.test.ts src/evolve-metric.test.ts src/evolve-score.test.ts src/evolve-archive.test.ts src/evolve-runner.test.ts
V-M-CLI-EVOLVE.Scenario: success: grace evolve --help lists init / run / show subcommands.
success: grace evolve init <topic> writes a starter spec.json and refuses to overwrite.
failure: grace evolve run exits 47 with per-error stderr when the spec fails validation.
success: grace evolve run produces docs/experiments/<topic>/results.xml after a successful loop.
